title: Reproducibility Report for SC25 Paper High-Performance Branch-Free Algorithms for Extended-Precision Floating-Point Arithmetic
motivation: Ensure reproducibility and artifact quality of SC papers
method: The evaluation process involves running the code and data from the original research to see if someone else can reproduce the same results. The team attempts to execute the implementation of high-performance branch-free algorithms for extended-precision floating-point arithmetic (computation using special high-accuracy math without conditional jumps in the code), documenting what functionality was tested and whether it produced the expected outputs. They check which components worked, which failed, and whether the original performance measurements held up under independent verification.
key_novelty: This report verifies whether the prior research on high-performance branch-free algorithms for extended-precision floating-point arithmetic can be independently reproduced and validated.
limitations: Scope limited to original paper's artifacts
